channel.title: The Apprentice
channel.desc: It's week 7, and the remaining candidates enter the world of gamified fitness. Their mission is to create a virtual reality demo of their game, design a brand that packs a punch and score big on investments. Both teams work up a sweat, and there's gamesmanship galore, but in the boardroom, there's no escaping the big boss.
